description: Checked-in latency budgets for continuous performance regression (MVP). Absolute ns/op varies by hardware; fail when measured p50/p95 exceed budget by more than tolerance_percent.
notes: Default sizes are CI-safe (1 MiB progressive, small L2 range, policy microbench).
Hardware variance: GitHub-hosted runners and developer laptops differ by 2–5× on ns/op; tolerance_percent defaults to 100 (2×).
Wire-byte and amplification contracts remain enforced by unit tests (LOG-001 / PERF-002); this gate is latency-oriented.
Optional larger sizes remain env-gated (PERF_BENCH_100MIB) and are out of default perf-regression.

BenchmarkGetBuildLogs_Progressive1MiB.notes: LOG-001 bounded progressive read; fixture only

BenchmarkL2PackRangeRead_Warm1MiB.notes: PERF-002 warm 8 KiB range on 1 MiB multi-frame pack
